title: BABOK: business analysis and structured requirements gathering

videos.script: Once a month, Joana spends two days matching the payment company's files against Carcará's sales. {{title}} Everybody agrees this should be automated. Nobody agrees on what that means. {{disagree}} Finance wants every cent explained. Payments wants nothing to change in the gateway integration. The auditors want a trail they can sample. {{stakeholders}} Business analysis is the discipline for this moment, and BABOK is its body of knowledge. {{babok}} This lesson walks through it with Joana's problem. Six core concepts that every change has. {{concepts}} The stakeholders, and how to find the ones nobody invited. {{who}} The techniques for asking, and four kinds of requirement that come out. {{kinds}} And what an architect takes from all of it, because sooner or later the analyst's work lands on your desk.
